title: Merge booked time blocks
trap: Touching blocks ([60,90] and [90,120]) must merge, a block inside another must not shrink it, and the input arrays must not be mutated or shared with the result.
prompt: Add mergeBlocks(blocks) to src/blocks.js. Each block is [start, end] in minutes with start <= end, in any order. Return the smallest list of blocks that covers exactly the same time, sorted by start. Do not change the input. Add tests in test/blocks.test.js.

files.src/blocks.js: export const length = ([start, end]) => end - start;
